s: A cozy child's bedroom at night; a small bear cub in striped pyjamas lies in a wooden bed, hugging a crescent-moon-shaped pillow to its cheek, eyes closed, a soft smile on its muzzle; a mother bear in a knitted shawl sits on the bed edge, one paw smoothing the blanket; a nightlight glows warm on the shelf. Deep blue room, warm golden lamp, peaceful sleepy mood.

A small bear cub tucked into bed under a quilt covered in embroidered glowing stars, only its head and one paw showing; the stars on the blanket cast a soft warm shimmer into the room; a mother bear leans in, her face gentle, one paw resting on the quilt edge; a round window shows the real night sky with matching stars. Deep indigo and warm gold, dreamy and calm.

A hillside meadow at sunset; a small rabbit with long ears stands on tiptoe reaching up with both paws toward a tiny fluffy pink-white cloud drifting low; the cloud has begun to look like cotton candy on a stick; a gentle breeze drawn as soft swirls helps pull it down; three small friends, a bird, a hedgehog and a squirrel, wait below with open paws. Warm peach and lilac sky, sweet dreamy mood.

A child's bedroom with the window open to a starry night; a small sheep in a nightcap lies in bed, one hoof under its cheek, eyes half closed; a tiny cloud has drifted in and settled under its head as a pillow, glowing faintly; curtains swaying gently, a crescent moon outside. Soft blue and cream, drifting sleepy atmosphere.

A windowsill at night; a small rabbit with drooping ears leans on the sill, chin on its paws, gazing up at a sky full of stars; a few stars have been left half-counted, drawn as small glowing dots above the rooftop; the rabbit's eyelids are heavy, one ear flopped over its eye. Indigo night, soft star glow, dreamy and quiet.

A window seat at night; a mother in a soft cardigan holds a small child in her lap, one hand gently patting the child's back, the other pointing at the sky; the child's head rests on her shoulder, eyes nearly closed, a tiny smile; a blanket over their knees, warm lamplight behind them, stars outside. Warm golden interior against deep blue night, tender drowsy mood.

Rooftops at night under a large moon; a small round postman in a soft blue coat and a nightcap with a tiny bell floats between chimneys, a plump cloth mailbag over his shoulder, one hand slipping a glowing dream through an open window; the bag glows faintly with tiny swirling dream shapes; a cat watches from a chimney pot. Deep blue with warm golden window lights, magical quiet mood.

A dark garden path at night; a small ant in a little scarf walks along a leaf-strewn trail, one hand shading its eyes; ahead, a line of fireflies hovers in a row like hanging lanterns, each with a warm glowing tail, lighting the way toward a small anthill with a lit doorway; tall grass on both sides. Deep green-blue night, warm golden dots, safe and comforting mood.

A summer meadow at night, seen from a low, dreamy angle; fireflies drift slowly among tall grass blades, each trailing a soft dim golden glow; one firefly in the foreground is enlarged, its tiny lantern-lit body glowing warmly; a child's bedroom window glows faintly in the far background. Deep blue-green, soft bokeh, hushed drowsy atmosphere.

A child's bedroom at night; a small boy in pyjamas kneels on the rug, carefully placing a toy car into a wooden toy box, one hand patting its roof; a ball and a few blocks are already in the box; the bed is turned down behind him, a nightlight glowing, the moon visible through the window. Warm dim light, tidy and peaceful mood.

A hillside at dusk; the sky is soft orange fading into purple; a small round cloud drifts slowly down behind a mountain ridge, one edge glowing from the last sunlight; below, a bird settles into its nest in a tree, river water smooth and still, flowers closing their petals. Warm gradient sky with cool shadows, gentle farewell mood.

A soft meadow at night; a small hedgehog sits curled up with its spines bristling, face buried, looking sad and lonely; around it three friends, a rabbit, a squirrel and a fawn, kneel close and gently touch its soft belly side, careful of the spines, their faces warm and reassuring; the hedgehog's eye peeks out, beginning to smile. Moonlight, soft warm glows, tender mood.

A tiled rooftop at night; a small orange kitten walks along the ridge, tail up, looking over its shoulder at a big round moon; the moon is drawn with a gentle smiling face and a soft halo; the kitten's mouth is open in a tiny meow; chimney pots, a clothesline, distant lit windows below. Deep indigo and silver, playful and calm.

A doorway at night; a single round paper lantern hangs from the eave, glowing warm orange, gently swaying, its tassel drifting; below, a stone step, a pair of small shoes and a cat curled asleep; a warm rectangle of light falls on the path from the partly open door; light snow or fine rain glinting. Very warm orange against cool blue night, welcoming mood.

A small bedroom at night; a little rabbit in a nightshirt sits up in bed, ears drooping, eyes wide open, one paw on the blanket, mouth in a small worried curve; a mother rabbit sits on the bed edge, one paw on her own chest demonstrating a slow breath, her face calm and smiling; a nightlight and a glass of water on the nightstand. Soft blue with warm lamp, soothing mood.

Underwater at night seen from near the seabed; a small<|place_holder_mm_span_0442|> turtle hatchling paddles through clear blue-green water, flippers wide, looking up; above the surface, a path of moonlight ripples down through the water like a silver road; seahorses and small fish float nearby, soft sea grass sways. Deep teal and silver, gentle drifting mood.

A warm sandy beach at night; a small sea turtle lies half-buried in the sand, eyes closed, flippers relaxed, a faint contented smile; above it a dream bubble shows the turtle gliding through bright water among colourful fish and soft sea grass; gentle waves rolling in, moonlight on the water. Warm sand with cool blue dream tones, deeply peaceful.

A night sky above a sleeping landscape; a row of small round stars with gentle sleeping faces hangs in a neat line, each glowing softly, one with a tiny open mouth as if humming; below, a treetop, a still pond and a small house with a dim window; thin musical note-like arcs of light drift between the stars (no letters). Deep blue, warm star glow, hushed lullaby mood.

A dreamlike bedroom turned into landscape: a soft plush toy train with a small bell on its front puffs along a track made of quilted blanket folds, passing a mountain of pillows and entering a tunnel of blankets; in one carriage a tiny bear sleeps curled up; stars glowing on the wall. Warm cream and pastel tones, whimsical sleepy mood.

A courtyard at night; small animals sit around a low wooden table, a bear cub in a scarf rolling white rice dough into round balls, a rabbit shaping one, a squirrel arranging finished balls on a plate; a steaming pot nearby; above them a huge full moon, and each rice ball catches a soft moonlight sheen. Warm lantern light, cosy festive mood.

A forest at night; a round owl with big amber eyes perches on a branch, head turned to one side, wings folded neatly, posture alert but calm; below in a hollow a small squirrel sleeps curled up, one ear twitching; moonlight filters through leaves, a few fireflies drifting. Deep blue-green, soft silver, safe and quiet mood.

A small bare tree on a hillside in early winter; fallen leaves gathered around its roots like a blanket, and the first soft snow settling on its branches and on the ground; the tree's trunk has a sleepy, peaceful face; a gentle wind drawn as soft swirls tucks the snow around it; a pale moon behind. Cool blue-white with warm brown bark, hushed peaceful mood.

A child's bed at night; a small child lies under a thick white quilt that puffs up like a cloud, only the face and one hand showing, eyes closed, cheeks relaxed; a mother's hand tucks the edge of the quilt near the child's shoulder; a soft nightlight and a glass of water on the nightstand. Warm cream and pale blue, deeply cosy mood.

A mountain stream at dusk flowing over smooth stones, water curling into small silver ripples with soft flowing lines; on the bank flowers have folded their petals, a bird sits tucked in a low branch with its head under its wing, and small trees lean over the water; the last warm light fades from the sky. Cool blue-green with a hint of warm gold, gently rhythmic mood.

A quiet street of small houses at night; a tiny postman in a soft blue coat and pointed nightcap floats past windows, a bulging cloth bag on his back glowing with faint colourful dream shapes; with one hand he slips a small glowing dream under a windowsill pillow visible through the glass; a cat dozes on a fence; a huge moon behind the rooftops. Deep blue, warm window lights, magical calm.

A windowsill at night; a child in pyjamas sits at the window, chin on hands, eyes still open; outside, a crescent moon shaped like a little boat with a soft glowing hull floats close to the window, one gentle wave-like curve inviting; a starry sky and the child's sleepy reflection in the glass. Deep indigo, silver glow, dreamy drifting mood.

A horizon at dawn; a round moon with a sleepy half-closed eye and a small yawn sits low in a sky of pale pink and lavender; beside it a few small stars are already fading and slipping away behind a cloud; below, a mountain ridge and a small house with a dim window; the first warm light rising on the opposite side. Soft pastel gradient, gentle drowsy mood.

A garden at night; flowers with closed petals stand in neat rows, their heads bowed, one or two with sleepy faces in their centres; round dew drops glint on broad leaves; a small cricket sits on a stone, legs folded, quiet; a low stone wall and a lantern with soft glow; above, a moon and a star or two. Deep blue-green, silver dew highlights, hushed peaceful mood.

A forest at night; a squirrel curled in a tree hollow with its tail over its nose, a small deer lying in soft grass with its head tucked to its flank, a bird with its head under its wing on a branch; moonlight falls in soft shafts through the canopy; a full moon above the treetops. Deep blue and silver, warm fur highlights, deeply calm mood.

A river at night winding through a meadow; the water flows in soft curling lines, suggesting a gentle melody, with faint glowing ripples; along the banks, a frog yawns with its mouth wide on a lily pad, a squirrel hugs its tail in a tree hollow, a small rabbit blinks sleepily in the grass; reeds sway. Deep blue-green, soft silver, sleepy rhythmic mood.

A bedroom window at night; a child in pyjamas leans on the sill, one hand raised with pinky finger extended toward the sky, face bright with a hopeful smile; outside, the brightest star has a gentle glowing face and a small pinky-like sparkle reaching back; a bed with turned-down covers behind, soft lamp light. Deep blue night, warm interior glow, tender promising mood.

A night sky; a very small star with drooping, sleepy eyes sits close beside a large round moon with a gentle motherly face, leaning against the moon's curve; the small star's glow is dim and flickering softly; around them other stars shine quietly; below, soft dark clouds and a sleeping landscape. Deep indigo, warm cream moonlight, tender drowsy mood.

A child's bed at night; a small bear cub lies under a quilt with one paw on its cheek; a mother bear leans in, one paw gently touching the cub's forehead, her face full of warmth, small heart-shaped glows drifting around her; a nightlight on the shelf, a crescent moon in the window. Warm rose and cream tones against deep blue, deeply loving mood.

A child's bedroom at night; a small girl in bed has pulled the blanket up to her eyes, only her worried eyes visible; on the nightstand a round little night lamp glows with a gentle warm halo and a kind, steady face; its light spreads softly across the wall, pushing back the shadows; a toy bear sits nearby. Deep blue shadows with a warm pool of light, reassuring mood.
